code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), suggestive of acute respiratory failure. There is mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, and increased red cell distribution width, which may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or acute illness. Mild monocytosis and basophilia are also present. Renal and liver function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
